verdict.rationale: Fastmail exposes its mail data through a documented JMAP API: session discovery at api.fastmail.com, API-token auth, and the ability to query, fetch and send in one request, plus push. Nothing in the evidence shows the API covers the rest of what the UI does, such as filters/rules, masked email, aliases, templates, snooze or scheduled send. missing for 10: evidence of API coverage for UI-only features (filters/rules, masked email, aliases, templates, scheduled send/snooze, calendar/contacts management), an explicit API-to-UI parity statement, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: The JMAP session resource can be found at https://api.fastmail.com/jmap/session
POST a `methodCalls` array. Query, fetch, and send, all in one HTTP request.
Get instant push via EventSource — one connection, all mailboxes.
